content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To live with a chronic illness, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Log daily symptoms in a health journal (1 week)
Step 2. Research local support groups (2 hours)
Step 3. Attend a nutrition seminar for specialized diets (3 hours)
Step 4. Get a second opinion from a specialist (2 weeks)
Step 5. Establish a sustainable long-term exercise routine (3 months)
Step 6. Install accessibility aids in the bathroom (4 hours)
Step 7. Apply for a medical leave of absence or workplace accommodations (1 month)
Step 8. Consult with a registered dietitian (2 hours)
Step 9. Schedule an initial diagnostic consultation (1 hour)
Step 10. Finalize a comprehensive 5-year wellness plan (1 week)
Step 11. Purchase a high-quality medical alert bracelet (15 minutes)
Step 12. Complete a series of blood panels and imaging (10 days)
Step 13. Receive an official diagnosis and treatment roadmap (3 days)
Step 14. Update emergency contact information (10 minutes)
Step 15. Organize a digital folder for all medical records (5 hours)
Step 16. Interview a potential home health aide (2 hours)
Step 17. Modify the home kitchen for easier meal prep (2 days)
Step 18. Undergo specialized genetic testing (3 weeks)
Step 19. Join an online patient advocacy forum (30 minutes)
Step 20. Attend an educational workshop on the illness (6 hours)
Step 21. Meet with a peer mentor for emotional support (90 minutes)
Step 22. Start a trial period for primary medication (1 month)
Step 23. Purchase ergonomic furniture for the home office (1 week)
Step 24. Set up a recurring prescription delivery service (20 minutes)
Step 25. Update your life insurance policy (2 weeks)
Step 26. Consult with a pharmacist about drug interactions (45 minutes)
Step 27. Hire a part-time cleaning service (1 hour)
Step 28. Review progress with a primary care physician (45 minutes)
Step 29. Evaluate the effectiveness of the medication trial (2 weeks)
Step 30. Discuss side effects with a nurse practitioner (30 minutes)
Step 31. Research anti-inflammatory meal prep recipes (4 hours)
Step 32. Meet with a social worker regarding disability benefits (2 hours)
Step 33. Adjust monthly budget for medical expenses (1 day)
Step 34. Coordinate a family meeting to discuss care needs (2 hours)
Step 35. Consult with a physical therapist (1 hour)
Step 36. Schedule a follow-up MRI (2 weeks)
Step 37. Audit home safety for mobility hazards (3 hours)
Step 38. Order a customized pill organizer (10 minutes)
Step 39. Practice mindfulness and meditation techniques (1 hour)
Step 40. Join a clinical trial database (1 hour)
Step 41. Visit an office supply store for filing materials (30 minutes)
Step 42. Buy a specialized orthopedic mattress (1 week)
Step 43. Read a comprehensive book on managing the condition (5 days)
Step 44. File an insurance appeal for denied claims (3 weeks)
Step 45. Schedule a session with a mental health counselor (1 hour)
Step 46. Volunteer for a local health awareness event (4 hours)
Step 47. Write a living will and power of attorney (4 days)
Step 48. Research medical equipment suppliers (3 hours)
Step 49. Apply for a parking permit for people with disabilities (2 weeks)
Step 50. Submit final paperwork to the insurance provider (2 hours)
